# Assessment Overview

This directory contains supplementary assessment fact documents generated during analysis.

- [architecture-diagram.md](./architecture-diagram.md) — High-level and component-level architecture diagrams.
- [dependency-map.md](./dependency-map.md) — External dependency inventory with categorized map and risks.
- [api-service-contracts.md](./api-service-contracts.md) — Service catalog, API contracts, and communication sequence.
- [data-architecture.md](./data-architecture.md) — Database and persistence model with ER diagram.
- [configuration-inventory.md](./configuration-inventory.md) — Externalized settings, profiles, and sensitive configuration inventory.
- [business-workflows.md](./business-workflows.md) — Core domain workflows, business rules, and process sequence.
